label: rem:categorical-sha-local-global
title: The $q$-Tate--Shafarevich group as the local-global obstruction
html:
The q-Tate--Shafarevich group \mathrm{Sha}_q(\mathcal{E}_q) measures the failure of the local-global principle at the q-scale: torsors trivial at every spectral localization but globally non-trivial.

Fibre-level facts used in the definition. In the categorical Mordell--Weil group construction, the elliptic fiber \mathcal{E}_q \hookrightarrow \mathcal{B} is a genus-1 sub-curve, and the Frobenius eigenvalue on H^1(\mathcal{E}_q) satisfies |\alpha_{\mathcal{E}}| = q^{1/2} by the Hasse--Weil bound. The fibre functor atlas of the QOU forms a G-gerbe over the spectral base.
